results.title: How to Fix OOMKilled Kubernetes Error (Exit Code 137)?
results.snippet: Use profiling tools like JVM’s built-in tools to detect and fix memory leaks in your application. Run kubectl describe pod [name] and save the content to a text file for future reference: kubectl describe pod [name] /tmp/troubleshooting_describe_pod.txt · Check the Events section of the describe pod text file, and look for the following message: State: Running Started: Thu, 10 Oct 2019 11:14:13 +0200 Last State: Terminated Reason: OOMKilled Exit Code: 137 ...
